name: Bariaur
traits: Medium Outsider native to Ysgard. It gains the Extraplanar subtype away from Ysgard. Racial adjustments are +2 Strength and −2 Charisma. Land speed 40 ft. and darkvision 60 ft.
Quadruped. +4 on checks to resist bull rush and trip, and 1½ times the normal carrying capacity for the Bariaur’s Strength. Bariaurs wear barding and cannot wear humanoid boots.

Powerful Charge. On a charge a Bariaur can make a single ram attack for 2d6 bludgeoning damage plus 1½ times its Strength modifier. Apply the normal charge rules. The trait only grants the ram during a charge.
Spell resistance equals 11 + class level. Bariaurs have a +2 racial bonus on Will saves against spells and spell-like abilities and a +2 racial bonus on Listen and Spot checks.
Celestial and Common are automatic. Abyssal and Infernal are bonus languages. Favored class Ranger. LA +1. The playable profile specifies no racial Hit Dice.
Page 8 identifies the larger Bariaurs in Book of Exalted Deeds as Exalted Bariaurs.
